plan.scope: Development annotation audit, separately from the structural-length and endpoint study. Original non-anatomical simulation sheet only. No closed loop, joint/closure permission, M5a sign-off, or formal holdout access.

audit_population.source: Phase A native 640 ECM frames, not auxiliary cameras, HD, look-back experiments, H1 or historical holdout frames. Use only the existing 270 training trajectories; the prior 30 development validation trajectories are not used for this audit.
audit_population.selection: Per scenario, the first 8 episodes in the existing Phase A hash order, across nominal, occlusion_transient, relax and slip_regrasp. Include every observation; retain FAILED trajectories. For visual review select in frame order up to two examples per deterministic category from different episodes.

label_contract.coordinates: Scorer-only camera XYZ (metres) and continuous UV from registered camera intrinsics and camera pose. Tip uses label_tcp_M translation. For the structural front independently reconstruct the row midpoint from label_nodes and exact cut length and compare to label_cut_front. Validate shapes, finiteness and paired presence; never reconstruct hidden targets into image pixels.
label_contract.tip: The TCP is a virtual point. Record out_of_view or depth_blocked separately. Tip positive candidates require the M5a depth-clear screen and all three fiducial spheres with at least 6 correctly coloured, depth-consistent pixels within the projected sphere radius plus 2 pixels; only these are candidates, not certified optical labels.
label_contract.front: Pre-sheet and loaded zero-length have no visible slit-apex label (a loaded entry landmark is a different task). For post-cut, depth-blocked means all nine rounded-centre 3x3 pixels are finite, valid and more than 3 mm nearer than the structural midpoint. For in-frame, coarse-clear points require a live triangle incident to each centre-bank node at the target row and corresponding depth support on each side to become geometry candidates. Restrict to the adjacent outer-band columns on each side; use triangle centroid and the three barycentric weights (0.6, 0.2, 0.2) permutations, count unique nearest pixels within 1 mm of sample depth. Minimum two distinct matching pixels per bank. This is conservative support, not proof that a slit terminus is visible or that it coincides with the structural midpoint.
label_contract.unknown: Unsupported or ambiguous points are not positive, and are not silently converted to hard occlusion/no-target negatives. Keep exact coordinates scorer-only. Tip and front statuses are independent; pre-sheet may still have a valid tip.
label_contract.visual_review: For front geometry candidates, view an unmarked local RGB crop first to check for an identifiable slit end, then compare against a copy with the structural projection overlaid. An identifiable visible slit tip must be separately annotated in the image and disagreement with the structural midpoint retained. A second independent reviewer and overlap across stitched scenarios are required before freezing trainable positive labels. Manual spot checks now are diagnostic, not certified labels.

evaluation_plan.separation: Freeze episode IDs and seeds for train, validation and a distinct future untouched landmark evaluation cohort before training. Any frames, optics, view twins, noise draws and augmentations from one episode stay in one partition. No structural-length H1 access. Holdout not collected here.
evaluation_plan.model_inputs: Clean RGB-D only (plus fixed camera intrinsics for backprojection); no world pose, motion history, targets, state, projected truth coordinates, constraints, visibility masks, training crop centered on truth, or frame number. Pose and truth are scorer/label-generation only.
evaluation_plan.outputs: Two independent landmark readouts with confidence and abstention. Record per-head 2D pixel error and camera-frame 3D median/p95, visible availability, valid-but-wrong using >2 mm as the historical reporting threshold on independently supported coordinates, abstentions on explicit occlusion/no-target, and zero-denominator status. For the optical front also report pixel accuracy against independently marked slit ends and report 3D only when its depth label is independently supported. Do not equate that estimate with verified structural progress or an endpoint.
evaluation_plan.evaluation: Report per-head metrics by scenario, measured visibility, before/after cut and depth variant (native and 0.5 mm Gaussian), with trajectory bootstrap uncertainty and missing-support counts. Same-batch reference: marker tip baseline and hand-written slit-front reader, using documented allowed inputs. Compare same scored population; report the historical M5a coarse visibility separately, not as acceptance. Choose and freeze thresholds on development validation only, before future evaluation; specification for label agreement, operating points and exact model/training budget must be frozen in a later version, before training.
